text: Frame-time acceptance (lead, 2026-10-04): 'no frame over 32 ms' is asserted as p99 ≤ 32 ms plus a worst frame ≤ 100 ms, locally and in CI, with the worst frame and its index printed on every run. A strict maximum over about 400 frames measures the shared workstation's load (33.5 ms at load average ~45, with p95 at 10 ms) rather than the table's virtualisation, which the ≤ 60-cell check pins. The release performance qualification (S10.6) owns any strict-max measurement on an idle machine.
